installId.description: Random install id, no account needed.

capturedAt.description: ISO time the event happened in-game.

sourceItemId.description: The item that was disenchanted or opened (a lockbox, a clam, a bag). Older addons send none.

lootType.description: What opened the window, from the spell cast just before it (`LOOT_TYPES`). Absent on windows from older addons and converted Recorder files; those are never sorted into a type by guessing.

copper.description: The coin in the window, in copper. Absent when the window held none or the addon could not read it.

sourceEvidence.description: Legacy target guesses are withheld from public loot observations.

mapId.description: With an object source: the map the player stood on when the object was opened. Older addons send none.

x.description: The player's x on that map, 0 to 100.

y.description: The player's y on that map, 0 to 100.

gatherKind.description: How the object was opened, from the spell cast on it (`GATHER_KINDS`); `other` when the spell is not one the addon knows.

sourceObjectName.description: The object's name as the game showed it. Public only when 3 installs agree on it.

description: Everloot upload record: loot. The server also checks: loot needs a source: npc, object or item; a loot position needs mapId, x and y together.
